The query joins Montgomery tracts to 2026 code-violation counts and CDC adult high-blood-pressure prevalence, computes violations per 1,000 adults, and returns the area-level correlation with tracts ranked by prevalence descending.
sql:
WITH paired AS (
  SELECT
    t.name AS tract_name,
    CAST(h.bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS bphigh_prevalence,
    COALESCE(n.n, 0) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(CAST(h.totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE), 0) AS code_violations_count_per_1000_totalpop18plus,
    COALESCE(n.n, 0) AS code_violations_count,
    CAST(h.totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS totalpop18plus,
    t.geoid AS geoid
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_counts n
    ON n.geoid = t.geoid
   AND n.run_id = 'r_20261026_977b0a'
   AND n.source = 'm1_city'
   AND n.grp = 'all'
  LEFT JOIN session.fw_977b0a_m2_cdc h
    ON h.tractfips = t.geoid
  WHERE CAST(h.totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) > 0
    AND h.bphigh_crudeprev IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  tract_name,
  bphigh_prevalence,
  code_violations_count_per_1000_totalpop18plus,
  code_violations_count,
  totalpop18plus,
  CORR(code_violations_count_per_1000_totalpop18plus, bphigh_prevalence) OVER () AS rate_prevalence_correlation,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY bphigh_prevalence DESC NULLS LAST, tract_name ASC
LIMIT 200
